First, note the given date is 08-21-1046 (MM-DD-YYYY).  
Add 270 days:  

1046 is not a leap year (divisible by 4 but not by 100? 1046 ÷ 4 = 261.5 → not divisible by 4, so not leap).  
Days remaining in 1046 after 08-21:  
Aug: 31 - 21 = 10 days left in Aug.  
Sep (30) + Oct (31) + Nov (30) + Dec (31) = 122 days.  
Total from Aug 22 to Dec 31 = 10 + 122 = 132 days.  

270 - 132 = 138 days into 1047.  
1047 is not leap (not divisible by 4).  
Jan 31, Feb 28, Mar 31, Apr 30, May 31 = 31+28+31+30+31 = 151 days from Jan 1 to May 31.  
138 days from Jan 1: Jan 31, Feb 28, Mar 31, Apr 30 = 31+28+31+30 = 120 days (end of Apr).  
138 - 120 = 18 days into May → May 18, 1047.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1047-05-18
